name: Dark mode body and heading text meet WCAG AA contrast
description: Dark mode body and heading text meet WCAG AA contrast.

planSteps.description: Toggle to dark mode on / and sample the contrast of body text and a heading
Verify body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 and large/heading text ≥ 3:1 in dark mode — no near-black-on-near-black low-contrast text.
